purpose: Shared ROP diagnostic core for MIRLEX ROP Expert. Converts preserved radar patterns into questions/checks without treating unrevalidated historic records as current legal conclusions.

execution_policy.legal_gate: Any rule whose provenance status is PRESERVED_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED may activate questions, evidence requests, contradictions and scope, but may not issue an automated legal debt/violation conclusion until current primary-source revalidation.
execution_policy.external_language: Calm client-facing wording; internal RED_FLAG remains hidden.

rules.trigger: ROP diagnostic starts or company role is unclear
rules.chain: COMPANY → FACTUAL_ROLE → MANUFACTURER/IMPORTER/CONTRACT_MANUFACTURING/SELLER → EAEU_OR_NON_EAEU → GOODS/PACKAGING → RELEASE/IMPORT_FACT → CONTROL_DATA_RECONCILIATION
checks: establish factual role before obligation route
compare claimed role with production/import evidence
flag mismatch between factual manufacturer and reporting entity
use interagency/GIS MT signals as reconciliation evidence, not standalone proof of debt
red_flags: claimed seller/brand owner but evidence indicates factual production/import
actual manufacturer differs from ROP reporting entity
import exists but origin/customs route unresolved
regulator notice exists while factual role remains unresolved

rules.trigger: manufacturer/importer route remains possible after role check
rules.chain: ROLE → GOODS/PACKAGING → CODES → PP_2414_SCOPE → MASS → PERIOD → REPORTING_CHAIN → ECOFEE_INPUT
checks: separate goods from packaging
preserve code-level provenance
reconcile mass across source documents and reporting forms
do not assume transition dates without current-source revalidation
red_flags: goods and packaging mixed without allocation

rules.trigger: client claims fulfillment through recycler or own recycling
rules.chain: OBLIGATION_VOLUME → RECYCLER → REGISTER_STATUS_BY_PERIOD → OPERATION/GROUP → CAPACITY → WASTE_INPUT → TECHNOLOGY → PRODUCT/SECONDARY_OUTPUT → ACT → RECYCLER_REPORTING → ELIGIBLE_CONFIRMED_VOLUME
checks: contract alone does not close verification
act alone does not close factual recycling check
check register status for relevant period
check operation/group correspondence
compare claimed volume with confirmed capacity
trace final recycler where intermediary chain exists
cross-check act with recycler reporting where available
version waste-to-product mapping by effective period
red_flags: recycler not traceable for relevant period
act exists but factual recycling/output is not traceable
intermediary exists but final recycler unresolved

rules.trigger: ROP reporting/calculation is being prepared or audited
checks: treat forms as dependent calculation chain
reconcile shared quantities between forms
trace every calculated value to source mass/evidence
red_flags: same quantity differs between dependent forms
recycling volume exceeds reconciled eligible volume

rules.trigger: producer claims reduction coefficient/secondary raw material benefit
rules.chain: PRODUCT → SECONDARY_RAW_MATERIAL → ORIGIN/ELIGIBILITY → TECHNOLOGICAL_CONFIRMATION → FACTUAL_PRODUCTION → MASS → ANTI_DOUBLE_COUNT → COEFFICIENT_INPUT
checks: detect possible double counting
separate factual production evidence from declaration
route exact eligibility to current-law verification
red_flags: same mass appears in multiple benefit/fulfillment routes
